description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the Comment-Before-Delete Rule — old summonCreature must be commented with a '// OLD:' marker inside a /* */ block, NOT simply deleted, and a new replacement function must exist below it. (2) Identify the 4 repeated CREATURE_TYPES.find() calls and extract them into a named helper function (SKILL.md: 3+ instances = extract helper). (3) Replace the hot-path CREATURE_TYPES.find() inside updateCreatures() (which runs 60fps) with a pre-indexed Map — per SKILL.md 'Object searches in loops → pre-index with a Map'. (4) Move CREATURE_TYPES data and SUMMON_LINES dialogue data to the top of the file, with all logic below (SKILL.md: data/logic separation). (5) Add save migration in loadGame() that copies creature.stamina to creature.energy and deletes the old field — following the exact migration pattern from SKILL.md. (6) Clean ghost variables (LEGACY_COLORS, comboMultiplier, comboTimer, leaderboardCache) by commenting or removing them.
